summary: Phase 6 wrap-up testing complete - All backend and frontend features tested successfully. Runtime settings module working perfectly with live updates from Admin Settings UI. Webhook signature verification confirmed using DB values. Full license lifecycle validated. No regressions found in core functionality.
passed_tests: GET /api/health returns 200 with status=ok
Admin login with admin@watchnexus.app returns JWT
GET /api/admin/settings returns runtime settings list with 15 settings, secrets properly masked (no raw values leaked)
PUT /api/admin/settings updates STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET and change reflects immediately (source=db) without restart
GET /api/admin/api-keys lists all keys including bootstrap key (17 keys found)
POST /api/admin/api-keys creates new API key with wnk_ prefix
POST /api/admin/api-keys/{id}/revoke successfully revokes API key
Full license lifecycle: create product → create license → activate → validate (valid) → revoke → validate (invalid)
Stripe webhook /api/webhooks/stripe verifies signature using DB value (not .env) - test secret set via runtime settings
LemonSqueezy webhook /api/webhooks/lemonsqueezy verifies signature using DB value - test secret set via runtime settings
Rate limit triggers 429 after 10 requests to /api/admin/login within 60 seconds
Audit log records mutations (settings.update increased count from 139 to 140)
Frontend: Admin login working, redirects to /admin dashboard
Frontend: Dashboard loads with 4 stat cards (licenses, installs, customers, products)
Frontend: Admin Settings page loads with all tabs (webhooks, email, branding)
Frontend: Runtime settings display correctly - Stripe webhook secret field present with masked value
Frontend: LemonSqueezy webhook secret field present with masked value
Frontend: EMAIL_FROM field can be edited and saved (toast confirmation shown)
Frontend: Settings persist after page reload (EMAIL_FROM value retained)
Frontend: Quickstart page loads with integration kit content, bootstrap API key (wnk_) visible, demo license (WNX-) present
Frontend: Products page loads correctly
Frontend: Licenses page loads correctly
Frontend: API Keys page loads correctly
Frontend: Customers page loads correctly
Frontend: Builds page loads correctly
Frontend: Webhooks page loads correctly (title is 'Webhook events')
Frontend: Audit page loads correctly with filters and event list
